items.title: The absolute Galois group acts transitively on the primes of the base change to a separable closure
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a field extension K of k and a separable algebraic closure, the absolute Galois group acts transitively on the primes of the base change of K to the closure (statement lines 11662-11668). The proof does not use the theory of the absolute Galois group as a profinite group: it passes to the intermediate subextension where the base change is a product of fields, notes that the relevant primes are maximal because the closure is algebraic, and realises the primes as kernels of the maps obtained by composing with the Galois translates (proof lines 11670-11696). Turning the orbits into kernels of the Galois translates is the step that gives transitivity. H2.
